page_title: ARS 2-1 NOT | Arsenal v Nottingham Forest 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+2' Michael Oliver has issued a yellow card to Ben White (Arsenal).
90+2' Arsenal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Today's match ends for Orel Mangala who will be replaced by Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham).
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Joe Worrall walks off the pitch to be replaced by Chris Wood (Nottingham).
87' One of the Nottingham players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
86' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel (Arsenal) replacing Gabriel Martinelli.

82' 2 - 1 Goal! Anthony Elanga produces a great pass that finds Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
81' Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.

81' Declan Rice (Arsenal) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Matt Turner easily deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
81' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Brennan Johnson will be replaced by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
80' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
78' The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
77' The referee awards a corner and Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) goes over to take it.

76' What a sweet touch by Declan Rice (Arsenal) after latching on to a fine pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and unleashes a cannonball close to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper makes a brilliant save, pushing the ball onto the post. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
76' 4:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
73' Substitution. Eddie Nketiah makes his way off the pitch and Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ola Aina leaves the pitch and Neco Williams (Nottingham) comes on.
71' Steven Cooper has decided to make a change. Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) replaces Danilo.
70' Ola Aina (Nottingham) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post. Nottingham force their opponents to concede a corner.
70' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nottingham.
70' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' William Saliba (Arsenal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
61' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
61' The possession of the ball – 84:16.
58' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
57' The attendance for today's match is 59984.
55' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) picks up a long through ball, but Matt Turner deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
53' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Matt Turner was alert and made a comfortable save.
50' Mikel Arteta is forced to make a change. Jurrien Timber is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal).
48' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
47' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45+3' It doesn’t look good for Jurrien Timber (Arsenal); looks like he’ll be heading for an early bath!
45+1' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

44' Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Matt Turner!
43' Ben White (Arsenal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
42' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
38' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
37' Joe Worrall (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but Aaron Ramsdale comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' 2 - 0 Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the left post in trademark fashion.
32' The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
31' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kai Havertz (Arsenal). Corner kick. Arsenal will have an opportunity.
30' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
28' Ola Aina (Nottingham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
26' 1 - 0 Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and drills in a superb strike that finds its way into the middle of the net.
26' Arsenal get a corner.
25' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
25' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
23' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) picks up a long through ball, but Matt Turner deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
21' The ball possession at the moment is 87:13.
16' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
15' The resulting set piece from Arsenal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Ben White (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. Arsenal can continue in their attacking effort.
11' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
10' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
8' Matt Turner displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
8' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' The corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared away by the defence.
4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. Arsenal earn a corner.
3' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
2' The Arsenal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has just begun.
